limitations: Controlled single-typology proof, not Miami or full-zone generation.
Explicit native mixed-running-bond placement retains its own orthogonal corner topology; no default placement or generic oblique/curved corner adapter.
Native lower/upper courses supply perimeter and interior positions relative to the independently selected spatial field; free interior populations need another authentic rule capability.
Native 1/128 ft snapping and binary upper rotation retained.
Opening diagnostics are geometric; near-occluded native slots are reported, not repaired by arbitrary geometry removal.
Multi-height arrangements, curved course generation and additional typology adapters remain unsupported.
